headword: {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}

definitions.explanation: Any drink that contains dissolved carbon dioxide, producing bubbles. Includes cola, ramune, cider, sparkling water, and other effervescent drinks.

examples.japanese: {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Carbonated drinks taste great on hot days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: For my health, I've been cutting back on carbonated drinks and drinking water instead.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧ (carbonic acid, carbonation) and ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧ (beverage). This is the standard general term for any carbonated drink, commonly seen on product labels, vending machines, and menus.

USAGE:
The formal term used in product categories and labels. In casual speech, people often just say ⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧ to mean carbonated drinks in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ — to drink a carbonated beverage
- {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧ — a vending machine for carbonated drinks
- ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう} — sugar-free carbonated drink
